text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by KPMG, to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2021. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy and Finance Committee meeting on May 24, 2022 and was received for information.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (May 24, 2022) from the Controller, Finance, Toronto Zoo, for information.
